name: Kiawah Island
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids on Kiawah Island, SC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids on Kiawah Island, SC in 2026: a free festival, Santa story time, a kids show and Christmas glow mini golf at Night Heron Park.
lede: Kiawah Island opens its Christmas season on Thanksgiving weekend, with free family events at Night Heron Park from a kids show to a festival, Santa story time and glow golf.
celebrates: Kiawah Island Golf Resort runs the island's Christmas calendar from Thanksgiving weekend through Christmas Day. The first weekend centers on Night Heron Park, where the resort lists Rick Hubbard's kids show, a Christmas Spectacular Festival with Santa's sleigh and elves, a Crosswind Farm animal visit, three Story Time with Santa sessions at the pavilion and a nine hole Christmas Glow Golf evening. The resort also lists a Sanctuary tree lighting with cookies, cocoa and carols, plus Santa's Arrival at The Sanctuary.
lastyear: We did not find a recap of the 2025 season, so this page relies on the resort's own 2026 Christmas page, which it updated in November. The Kiawah Island Community Association also lists its annual holiday tree lighting at the Sandcastle for Thursday, December 3, from 5 to 7 pm, and invites neighbors to join. We held that event because its page speaks to island residents, and we could not confirm that visitors can attend.
facts: Night Heron Park, the setting for the festival, the kids show stage, the story pavilion and the glow golf course, is on Kiawah Island Golf Resort property and has a Treehouse Activity Center and Treehouse Art Studio. The resort takes reservations for its paid activities at 843 768 6001, and its Kid's Night Out for ages 6 to 12 is priced separately on its KampKiawah site. The resort says its schedule is subject to change, so families should check its Christmas page before heading out.
trains: We did not find a holiday train ride on Kiawah Island or Seabrook Island this season, and the Christmas events here center on Night Heron Park and The Sanctuary. Families who want a train stop on the same trip can visit the Best Friend Train Museum in downtown Charleston, which Rally lists with free admission and a full size replica of the Best Friend of Charleston, the first locomotive built entirely in the United States.
train_links: A full size replica of the first locomotive built entirely in the United States, with free admission in downtown Charleston.
traditions: The resort fills Night Heron Park with music, face painting, a photo booth and Santa's sleigh with elves.
A horse, a camel, goats, bunnies and a llama visit the park from 2:30 to 4 pm.
Santa reads stories and leads a sing-a-long at Night Heron Pavilion.
The resort lists cookies, cocoa and live Christmas carols at The Sanctuary.
Families putt through nine Christmas decorated holes at Night Heron Park.
kidfact: Kiawah's Crosswind Farm visit brings a horse and a camel to Night Heron Park, and kids can also tell stories to a llama, according to the resort.
faq: Are there free Christmas events for kids on Kiawah Island?

Yes. Kiawah Island Golf Resort lists the Christmas Spectacular Festival, Rick Hubbard's kids show, Story Time with Santa and Christmas Glow Golf as complimentary, with no reservations required. Cocoa, a snowman snack and crafts are sold at the festival starting at 1 pm.
Can kids meet Santa on Kiawah Island?

Yes. Santa reads stories at Night Heron Pavilion on Friday, November 27, at 1:30 pm and on Saturday, November 28, at 9 am and 11:30 am. The resort also lists Santa's sleigh with elves at the festival and Santa's Arrival at The Sanctuary.
Is there a Christmas tree lighting on Kiawah Island?

Yes. The resort lists a Sanctuary tree lighting with complimentary cookies and cocoa while supplies last and live Christmas carols. We could not confirm its date and time on the page we read, so check the resort's Christmas page or call 843 768 6001 before you go.
What is happening on Kiawah Island on the Friday after Thanksgiving?

The resort lists Rick Hubbard's kids show at 9:30 am, the Christmas Spectacular Festival from noon to 4 pm, Story Time with Santa at 1:30 pm, a Crosswind Farm visit at 2:30 pm and Christmas Glow Golf from 5:30 to 8:30 pm, all at Night Heron Park.
Are there events on Seabrook Island for kids?

We could not verify a Seabrook Island Christmas event for kids on a host page this season, so this page lists only the Kiawah Island Golf Resort events. Seabrook families can also browse our Charleston guide for more Christmas activities for kids across the region, and we will add a Seabrook event once a host page confirms one.
